entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GAUTAM KUMAR CHOUDHARY

For the Petitioner : Ms.
Nirupama, Advocate For the State : Mr. Manoj Kumar, G.A. III ------
Order No.02 Dated : 08.08.2025 Heard both the sides.

The petitioner- Vikash Dhar Pal is in custody since 20.01.2024 in connection with Cyber P.S. Case No. 60 of 2023 corresponding to Cyber Case No.2 of 2024 for the offence registered under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B of the IPC and Sections 66(B), 66(C) and 66(D) of the I.T. Act pending in the Court of learned Additional Judicial Commissioner II, Ranchi.
Earlier bail application of this petitioner was rejected on 06.09.2024 with an observation to conclude the trial within six months from the date of framing of charge.
It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that more than a year has elapsed since passing the order, but the trial has not been concluded.
Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer for bail.

Under the circumstances, the above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Court below.
